_written: 2026-10-14, BEFORE any gen44 number was computed (Deribit funding downloaded on 2026-10-13, only coverage checked).
idea: market-neutral funding carry (long spot / short perpetual) for steady monthly income on an own exchange account (NOT a CFT strategy: CFT Bybit route has no funding); and as a stabiliser next to directional C*
rule H_CARRY (fixed): per coin: in position when the trailing 7-day mean of interest_8h, annualised (x 3 x 365), is > 5%; exit when it is < 0; position = long spot + short perp of equal notional; hourly P&L = +interest_1h on notional while in position (funding paid by longs to shorts when positive); price P&L hedged (basis noise ignored except as stress)
costs: entry + exit = 4 legs x (5.5 bp taker + 2 bp slippage) = 30 bp of notional per round trip; capital = 1.25 x notional (spot fully paid + 25% perp margin); stress: 2x costs and basis noise = daily N(0, 10 bp) on notional
gates ('STEADY CARRY'): TEST: share of positive months >= 0.75, net Sharpe >= 2.0, CAGR on capital >= 4%; stress TEST Sharpe >= 1.0
combination: C* (gen38, 15% vol) + H_CARRY (both coins, 50/50) at equal capital weights: report share of positive months, worst month, Sharpe, CAGR 2019/2020..2026
